verdict.rationale: Gemini has a documented public REST API: the Gemini API docs describe building production apps and agents, a machine-readable discovery document is published at generativelanguage.googleapis.com, and a Batch API is documented. However, the runtime probe found that the Gemini consumer app exposes no agent or API discovery surface and treats the developer API as a separate product, so the app's own features cannot be shown to be API-drivable. missing for 10: documented API control of Gemini app features (Gems, scheduled actions, notebooks, Connected Apps, Deep Research), API surface on the consumer app itself, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Go from a quick prompt to production apps and agents with the Gemini API.
